Form No. 9
K.R.R.—1920-10-17.

Shanghai Municipal Police.
（印：FILED 1641 21/12/17）

West Hongkew Station.
19th December 1917

REPORT ON conversation with Dr.Kindler.

Made by D.S.MacDermott Forwarded by J. W. Bryson. Inspector.

Sir-
I beg to report that this morning at the Mixed Court
I had a conversation with Dr. Kindler. In the course of
our conversation Dr. Kindler said that he and I could make
money, as he knew people who were engaged in opium smuggling,
and where the opium was being smuggled into Shanghai.
He said he could let me know when the opium was to arrive
and as to how I could identify the box etc., On account
of me attending the Shanghai Nanking Railway Station he
said, I could seize the opium and arrest the smuggler, and
then he (Dr.Kindler) could accidentally meet us and of course
things could be arranged so that no prosecution would
follow. As a result of this Dr.Kindler said, the people
engaged in the smuggling would likely offer some money
for things to be let alone, and I should probably get $200.00
or $300.00 a month. I refused, but he (Dr Kindler) said
nobody would know anything about it, and suchlike remarks,
to which I did not reply, and the conversation on this
subject then dropped. It is likely, in my opinion, that
Dr.Kindler shall again approach me on the matter.
hm
C.D.Inspector.,
C.I.D.Office,
Central.
（批：ASH 20/12）

I am
Sir
Your Obedient Servant,
W Mac Dermott
Det.Sergt.,

表格第9号
K.R.R.—1920-10-17。

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
（印：归档 1641 17/12/21）

虹口西区捕房。
1917年12月19日

关于与金德勒博士（Dr. Kindler）谈话的报告。

由警佐D.S.麦克德莫特（D.S. MacDermott）撰写，经督察J. W. 布赖森（J. W. Bryson）转呈。

先生——
谨此报告，今晨在会审公廨，我与金德勒博士进行了一次谈话。在谈话过程中，金德勒博士称，他和本人可以从中牟利，因为他认识一些从事鸦片走私的人，并知道鸦片被走私进入上海的地点。他说，他可以告知我鸦片抵达的时间，以及如何识别装运鸦片的箱子等物。鉴于本人在上海北站执勤，他说，我可以查扣鸦片并逮捕走私者，随后他（金德勒博士）可以“偶然”与我们相遇，当然事情可以安排妥当，以免引发起诉。金德勒博士称，作为这一安排的结果，从事走私活动的人很可能会为了息事宁人而提供一笔钱，我每月大概可获得200.00美元或300.00美元。我予以拒绝，但他（金德勒博士）称无人会知晓此事，并说了诸如此类的话，对此我未作回应，随后关于此话题的谈话便告终止。依我之见，金德勒博士很可能再次就此事与我接触。
hm
刑事侦缉处督察，
中央刑事侦缉处办公室。
（批注：ASH 12月20日）

我是
先生
您顺从的仆人，
W. 麦克德莫特
警佐，
